summary: Eclipse Che is an open source workspace server and cloud-based integrated development environment. It allows developers to host and access coding environments directly from a browser. The platform relies on containerised workspaces to manage development tools and source code on a remote server.
goodFor: It is well-suited for teams wanting to standardise developer workstations or centralise development environments on private infrastructure.
watchOut: Running a multi-container cloud IDE server introduces a significant operational burden and demands substantial server resources compared to local editors.
deployNotes: Deployment typically relies on Docker and Java runtimes, meaning you will need to configure persistent volumes for user data and a reverse proxy to handle secure TLS connections.
